concerns.text: SC-003 states 'peak memory usage... must remain within acceptable system constraints' without defining the constraint. This contradicts the specific 7 GB limit defined in US-3 and FR-005. SC-003 should explicitly reference the 7 GB limit to ensure terminological stability and testability.

SC-004 references 'statistical comparison (paired t-test)' but does not specify the confidence level or alpha threshold (e.g., p < 0.05) within the SC text itself, whereas US-1/US-2 acceptance scenarios imply a specific statistical outcome. While the methodology is clear, the SC text should be self-contained to avoid ambiguity.
